reference_sql:
WITH by_quarter AS (
  -- one row per signup country in 2025
  SELECT country_code,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts) = 1) AS q1,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts) = 2) AS q2,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts) = 3) AS q3,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts) = 4) AS q4,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
    AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT country_code, q1, q2, q3, q4, total,
  ROUND(100.0 * q4 / total, 1) AS q4_share_pct
FROM by_quarter

solver.query:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT country_code,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 1) AS q1,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 2) AS q2,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 3) AS q3,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE quarter(signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 4) AS q4,
    COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM signups
  WHERE (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (signup_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT country_code, q1, q2, q3, q4, total, ROUND(100.0 * q4 / total, 1) AS q4_share_pct
FROM t
